narrative: Medical provider failed to file claim with active health insurance, ignored coding error within timely filing window, and transferred unbilled sticker-price balance directly to collections.
violation_trigger: Seeking payment or initiating collection actions prior to required screening.
consumer_remedy: Mandatory reversal of collection actions and full refund of excess amounts paid.

narrative: Debt collector pursued spouse for adult medical debt after explicit notice of non-liability and refusal to correct mismatched identifiers.
statutory_rule: Sec. 9(a)-(c) Family and Third-Party Liability Protections
violation_trigger: Attempting to collect an adult medical debt from a spouse or family member.
consumer_remedy: Complete exemption from personal liability and dismissal of collection lawsuits.

friction_pattern: Validation Rights Ignorance & Truncated Dispute Windows
narrative: Debt collector failed to send 30-day written validation notice, demanded response within 10 days, and refused to substantiate debt upon certified dispute.
statutory_rule: 12 CFR 1006.34 Debt Collection Validation Notice Rule
violation_trigger: Unlawfully shortening dispute window and continuing active reporting without debt substantiation.
consumer_remedy: Mandatory pause on collections and removal of unsubstantiated trade lines.

friction_pattern: Unlawful Balance Billing & Collection of Charity Care Write-Offs
narrative: Collector pursued balance designated as 100 percent Provider Responsibility under managed care contract and approved for hospital charity care.
statutory_rule: Sec. 4(f), 4(g) Interest Rate and Fee Caps
violation_trigger: Assessing fees or pursuing collection on accounts approved for financial assistance.
consumer_remedy: Reversal of collection, zero interest cap enforcement, and refund of seized funds.

narrative: Collection agency conducted rapid call barrages, ignored written cease-and-desist notice, and threatened illegal credit reporting on debt under 500 dollars.
statutory_rule: Sec. 7(b), 7(c), 7(f)(1) Credit Reporting Ban and ECA Timelines
violation_trigger: Threatening credit reporting within protected moratorium or below statutory reporting thresholds.
consumer_remedy: Mandatory deletion of negative reporting and cessation of collection activities.
